_comment: Cards implemented by a subsystem OTHER than the [effect:X] villain-ability pipeline (setup:require-to-defeat, scoring:dynamic-vp). The villain-mechanic-ledger emits status 'subsystem' (implemented, done — NOT a TODO) for a would-be-'(unmarked)' card listed here. The subsystem status ONLY replaces a would-be-'(unmarked)' classification: a card that also carries an [effect:X] ability (e.g. Venom / Zombie Venom carry [effect:gainWoundEachPlayer], core Ultron carries [effect:reveal-or-wound]) surfaces as 'executable' from that marker, and its entry here documents the additional subsystem coverage without overriding the effect-marker path. Curated: a card joins ONLY when its subsystem implementation is merged. Keyed by the per-card ledger ext_id {setAbbr}-villain-{groupSlug}-{cardSlug}.
_heroesComment: Hero cards implemented by a subsystem OTHER than the [effect:X] hero-ability pipeline. Reclassified unsupported → subsystem per D-24514, applying this file's own rule (a pair joins once its implementation is merged). The hero row keeps its REAL mechanic name (the join key for the effect-implementation index and the /coverage by-mechanic table) and takes wp / decision / handler from the entry. Curated: a pair joins ONLY when its subsystem implementation is merged. See D-24368.
